data.summary_suggestion: Create a new vehicle or composition
data.description_suggestion: Creates a new vehicle or composition in the system. Accepts vehicle or composition data via RequisicaoCriacaoDeVeiculo schema. The application calculates a version hashcode based on vehicle attributes for change tracking. Returns HTTP 201 with RespostaCriacaoDeVeiculo containing the created vehicle ID and version information. Requires authentication via bearer token.

data.current_description: Atualiza dados do veículo ou composição.
data.description_suggestion: Updates vehicle or composition data in the system. Accepts RequisicaoAtualizacaoDeVeiculo with updated attributes. The application recalculates the vehicle version hashcode based on the new request data; if the new version differs from the current version, the update is applied. Returns HTTP 200 with RespostaAtualizacaoDeVeiculo containing the updated vehicle ID and new version information. Supports partial updates - only provided fields are modified. Requires authentication via bearer token.

data.current_description: Remove logicamente um veículo ou composição. Caso já tenha sido excluído apenas ignora a requisição.
data.summary_suggestion: Logically delete a vehicle or composition
data.description_suggestion: Logically deletes a vehicle or composition from the system (soft delete). Requires two parameters to identify the target vehicle. If the vehicle has already been deleted, the operation idempotently ignores the request and returns success. Returns HTTP 200 on successful deletion. Requires authentication via bearer token. Note: This is a logical deletion; the vehicle record remains in the database but is marked as deleted.
